bullets.text: A contract worker suffered a broken leg in an accident at the Kattupalli desalination plant in Ponneri, Thiruvallur district, leading to a family sit-in protest demanding proper compensation.
A four-hour power outage in Gummidipoondi sparked a sudden public road blockade on the highway.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chief Minister Vijay jointly inaugurated and traveled on the new Poonamallee to Porur and Vadapalani metro rail service in Chennai.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Chennai to launch development projects, while political tensions and protests regarding the CEC and other issues unfolded across the city.
A Poclain machine suddenly caught fire and burned in the Buckingham Canal.
Suzlon Group plans to invest 550 crore rupees to establish three AI-powered wind turbine blade factories, including one in Tamil Nadu, creating jobs by 2027.
Google stated that its planned artificial intelligence data centre in Visakhapatnam will use air cooling instead of water following local resident objections.
Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella urged companies deploying advanced AI systems to establish emergency brakes, warning against trusting models blindly.
Chennai witnessed youth and activist protests across four locations demanding the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
Over twenty Congress leaders in Chennai were placed under house arrest as they attempted to protest against Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi arrived in Chennai to launch the Chennai Metro Rail Phase 2 services alongside Chief Minister Vijay.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi is set to launch thirteen thousand crore rupees worth of various development projects during his one-day visit to Chennai.
